parts.text:
The Tsaritsa has a new assignment for you, one that seems to have something to do with the eating habits of Snezhnaya's people...

#### Go to the Zapolyarny Palace

**Paimon:** Your Majesty, we're here!

**Paimon:** Uh, looks like this isn't a good time...

**Anastasya:** Be seated.

- **Traveler:** Sorry to interrupt your meal.

**Anastasya:** No matter. I would not have summoned you without important business to discuss.

**Anastasya:** Since it is mealtime, we may as well talk about food. How much do you know about what ordinary people in Snezhnaya eat?

- **Traveler:** Paimon's a floating encyclopedia of everything worth eating in Teyvat.

**Paimon:** Hehe, Paimon does know a thing or two! But you're not just asking what's good to eat around here, are you, Your Majesty?

**Paimon:** After all, you must have tried every delicious dish Snezhnaya has to offer already!

**Paimon:** (Maybe she disguises herself as a commoner and sneaks out of the palace for a good meal, just like in a Yae Publishing House novel...)

**Anastasya:** I have. Though I suspect not in the way you imagine.

**Paimon:** P—Paimon wasn't imagining you sneaking around in disguise or anything!

**Anastasya:** ...?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** (With a presence like hers...)

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** (She'd have a hard time going incognito...)

##### Shared continuation

**Anastasya:** ...Every dish served in this palace is prepared with the greatest care by the head chef from rare ingredients sent from every corner of the realm. Even the humblest of street foods are no exception.

**Anastasya:** The demands of my duties have kept me too occupied these past few months to go out among the people myself.

**Anastasya:** Which is to say, I cannot easily keep abreast of what they actually eat each day.

**Anastasya:** Yet food and warmth are matters of paramount importance. In a land as bitterly cold as ours, hunger often means death. I will tolerate no lapses in this regard.

**Anastasya:** That is why I have charged Danica with overseeing the trade in foodstuffs on my behalf, and with watching closely for any changes in what my subjects put on their tables.

**Anastasya:** As for the specifics... Danica.

**Danica:** Yes, Your Majesty.

**Danica:** Since receiving Her Majesty's orders, I have conducted a special survey of food and dining across all of Snezhnaya each month, with the Druzhna's assistance.

**Danica:** From changes in home recipes to the transport and distribution of fruit, vegetables, and meat, to menu prices at restaurants in every region, all of it is compiled and submitted for Her Majesty's review.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** For all of... Snezhnaya?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** How do you manage that?

##### Shared continuation

**Danica:** Wherever the wind and snow reach, all must submit to Her Majesty's will. Each of us merely performs our respective duties.

**Paimon:** So, what do you plan to do with all that information, Your Majesty?

**Anastasya:** The accounts for food have always been tangled. And the more tangled they are, the easier it is to conceal corruption, and the more opportunists will seek to exploit the chaos to line their own pockets.

**Paimon:** Uh... Paimon doesn't really get it, but surely no one would dare to mess with food, right? After all, if everyone goes hungry, wouldn't they get caught right away!?

**Anastasya:** Greed always clouds people's judgment.

**Anastasya:** They buy up produce cheaply and hoard it in bulk, upend prices by speculating in grain, and then they lay all the blame on Project Stuzha.

**Anastasya:** Not long ago, I appointed a special investigator to look into the matter.

**Anastasya:** Sadly, it was not long before they began colluding with the grain speculators, trying to deceive me with falsified ledgers, imagining that I would be deceived.

**Anastasya:** They believed the Zapolyarny Palace would never trouble itself over such paltry profits, after all. Unfortunately, their deception was so clumsy that even Pantalone could see through it with his eyes closed.

**Paimon:** It'd be weirder if they actually managed to fool "Regrator"...

**Anastasya:** Fools. Eating away at the people's tables like termites. How is that any different from eating away at Snezhnaya itself? Do they imagine they should sleep in peace after such vile conduct?

**Anastasya:** As I said before, Danica is in charge of this matter. But you are my Privy Councilor, and I would have you participate in the investigation as well.

**Anastasya:** Danica. Where does this month's investigation stand?

**Danica:** Your Majesty. The audits and personnel reviews are largely complete. One task remains: sampling and taste-testing the dishes commonly sold for public consumption.

**Anastasya:** Mmm. I believe we shall let Traveler and Paimon handle that task. Danica, your assessment.

**Danica:** No objections. During previous inspections, I also discovered that some vendors deliberately used better ingredients and took greater care when preparing the dishes I sampled.

**Danica:** ...I have likely made one too many appearances. They know what I am there for, and thus prepare accordingly.

**Danica:** This will be Traveler's first inspection. I expect the samples he brings back will reflect the true quality of what is normally served. / This will be Traveler's first inspection. I expect the samples she brings back will reflect the true quality of what is normally served.

**Paimon:** Ooh, so that's the idea. "Sampling and taste-testing"... Hehe, so basically, we go grab some good grub and bring it back for you to try, right, Your Majesty?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** What kind of food should we choose?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Do you have any specific preferences?

##### Shared continuation

**Danica:** There is no need to overthink it. Simply bring back whatever you feel warrants a closer look to the Palace.

**Anastasya:** Then it is settled. Go, Traveler, Paimon. And should you have any questions, ask Danica.

**Paimon:** Gotcha! We'll get this done, no problem!

**Chayka:** Everyday dishes that warrant a closer look... Where should we even begin?

**Paimon:** Hehe, no need to worry, Chayka. Paimon's already got it all figured out!

**Paimon:** First stop's gotta be Podvorye Restaurant, no question! When it comes to "local" eats in Snezhnograd, that's the place, hands down.

**Paimon:** Then we can go check out the station! Lots of people travel by train, so dining-car food must be super popular with "ordinary people" too!

**Paimon:** That way, we can bring back a few different dishes for Her Majesty to try!

- **Traveler:** This really is your area of expertise...

**Paimon:** See? Paimon's always said that a passion for food would come in handy someday! Come to think of it, this assignment is practically tailor-made for Paimon. All the more reason we've gotta do it right!

**Chayka:** Then it seems we'll be relying on your expertise for this mission, Lady Paimon. Should you require any assistance, feel free to contact me at any time.

**Paimon:** Yup, just leave it to us for now!

#### Go to the Podvorye Restaurant

**Buturlina:** Welcome to Podvorye Restaurant! What would you two like to order?

**Paimon:** Hmm, Paimon'll have... Oh! Uh, sorry, force of habit. We're actually here to ask a few questions!

- **Traveler:** So this is "serious Paimon"...

**Buturlina:** Of course, what would you like to know?

**Paimon:** Which dish do your customers usually order most?

**Buturlina:** I can recommend every dish on the menu! Anything that has stood the test of time and stayed on the menu has more than earned its spot there.

**Buturlina:** But if you're asking what they order most often...

**Buturlina:** Most order a bowl of borscht the moment they arrive, to warm up. And on their way out, many take some smoked sausage to go. It keeps very well.

**Paimon:** Oh, Paimon totally gets it! Nothing like a bowl of borscht to warm you right up, and the smoked sausages here are super tasty! Well, regular sausages are delicious too, but—

**Paimon:** ...Ahem! Anyway, thanks a bunch! We'll just get one portion to go for now. We'll come back and have a big feast next time for sure!

**Paimon:** Hmm, gotcha... That does sound pretty tasty. Hehe, c'mon, Traveler, let's get those two for now.

**Paimon:** We'll take one of each, please! And we'll be back for a big feast next time.

**Buturlina:** Thank you for your patronage. I look forward to seeing you both again.

**Chayka:** If you need any help, you can always contact me.

#### Go to the Central Station

**Paimon:** Hi there!

**Iliana:** I'm Iliana, one of the conductors here. Can I help you two with something? Did you accidentally drop something valuable below the platform?

**Paimon:** No, no! We just wanted to ask... What do people order most often in the dining cars?

**Iliana:** That's not really my department... But since you asked, let me see what I can find out for you!

**Paimon:** Oh geez, Paimon didn't mean to make her go that far...

**Iliana:** Finally! Got your answer. My mentor really has seen it all. The most popular dish in the dining cars is definitely zharkoye, and it isn't even close.

**Iliana:** Whether they're riding the trains or waiting at the station, everyone loves it.

**Paimon:** Ooh, that's another one Paimon knows! Zharkoye smells sooo good! We'll take one serving, please!

**Paimon:** Ooh, that's a new one for Paimon! Now she's kinda curious how it tastes... Where can we buy the recipe?

##### Response branch 1

**Iliana:** At Rankova Zorya.

##### Response branch 2

**Iliana:** It could be purchased at Rankova Zorya before, but the station is currently under renovation, so it may be some time before it becomes available again.

##### Shared continuation

**Paimon:** Great! Then we'll have one serving of zharkoye for now, please! As for the recipe... Let's swing by and buy a copy when we have time, Traveler.

#### Return to Zapolyarny Palace

**Chayka:** Welcome back, Councilor, Lady Paimon! Did you two find suitable dishes?

**Chayka:** Whenever you're ready, just let me know.

#### Hand the dishes over to Chayka

**Chayka:** Thank you both for your hard work! Now then, please wait a moment...

#### Answer the Tsaritsa's questions

**Anastasya:** Hmm... Then please begin by explaining how these three dishes are prepared.

**Paimon:** Oh, they're all super simple to make! You did ask for home cooking, after all, Your Majesty.

**Paimon:** So, for borscht, just boil red beets, potatoes, and meat together, then add some smetana. Down a bowl, and you'll be warm and toasty all over. De~licious!

**Paimon:** Smoked sausage is... uh, smoked sausage. You season the sausage with pepper like the recipe says, then let it cure for a while. Also delicious!

**Paimon:** And as for zharkoye, it's basically carrots, potatoes, and meat cooked together, again with some smetana added...

**Paimon:** But some zharkoye in your tummy before your train leaves really hits the spot! It's absolutely delicious!

**Anastasya:** Excellent choices. In Danica's earlier reports, these dishes also ranked near the top in both sales and public opinion.

**Anastasya:** What do you think, Danica?

**Danica:** I have no objections. Traveler and Paimon's assessment of the food's quality is sound.

**Paimon:** Hehe, of course! When it comes to eating good food, Paimon's second to none!

- **Traveler:** That's Paimon for you...

**Danica:** I have already had agents investigate the shops Traveler and Paimon visited. There are no issues with their ingredient sourcing or prices, and customer opinion has been relatively consistent.

**Paimon:** Yeah, that sounds about... Huh? Wait, you already investigated them, Danica?

**Danica:** Just doing my job.

**Anastasya:** Well done. Continue overseeing the food supply. Should any problems arise, report them to me promptly.

**Danica:** Yes, Your Majesty.

**Anastasya:** As for those who embezzled funds, demanded bribes, and profiteered from foodstuffs... Since they are so concerned with the price of carrots and potatoes, let them grow carrots and potatoes.

**Anastasya:** Find them an empty patch of uncultivated land near Teplo. There they may farm to their hearts' content.

**Anastasya:** They need not return until they understand that Mora fills no stomachs. Only carrots and potatoes make soup.

**Anastasya:** I understand how complex and tedious the food accounts are. The inspectors must travel far and wide, and the work exhausts both body and mind.

**Anastasya:** It is for this reason that they were granted ample authority and funding. Those who dedicate themselves to the welfare of Snezhnayans deserve to be handsomely rewarded.

**Anastasya:** But I fear it is as Strivozha once told me: "Appetite comes with eating, yet hunger never leaves..."

**Anastasya:** As they are insatiable, the law will deal with them.

**Danica:** The Druzhna assist with gathering dining statistics, so my own workload isn't too excessive.

**Danica:** After the data is collected, a dedicated team performs the detailed calculations and checks. The results come to me, and I present them to Her Majesty.

**Danica:** It may sound complicated, but under Her Majesty's arrangements, everything runs in good order. And thanks to everyone's diligence, there has not been a single miscalculation to date.
